title: Ethereal Tree of Life
description: A massive, gnarled white tree with stained glass leaves dominates a cosmic night sky filled with aurora borealis. A cloaked figure with a flowing blue and gold robe floats above an ornate circular fountain, from which waterfalls cascade while the tree's roots form a dragon-like mouth breathing light.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a massive ancient gnarled white tree with stained glass mosaic leaves against a starry cosmic sky with swirling purple and green aurora borealis. The tree has a dragon-like open mouth with glowing interior. A mysterious cloaked figure in flowing dark blue and gold robes floats gracefully above an ornate circular stone fountain pool at the base. Multiple waterfalls cascade from the branches and into the glowing pool which has intricate golden patterns. Mystical atmosphere with birds and stone statues, intricate details, vibrant yet dark color palette.
